class.name: IfcCartesianTransformationOperator3DnonUniform
class.brief_description: A Cartesian transformation operator 3d non uniform defines a geometric transformation in three-dimensional space composed of translation, rotation, mirroring and non uniform scaling. Non uniform scaling is given by three different scaling factors: SELF\IfcCartesianTransformationOperator.Scale : the x axis scale factor Scale2 : the y axis scale factor Scale3 : the z axis scale factor If the Scale f

members.member: The scaling value specified for the transformation along the axis 2. This is normally the y scale factor.
The scaling value specified for the transformation along the axis 3. This is normally the z scale factor.
